states.meaning: Gentle, small torso sway with relaxed arms and both feet planted.
Head slowly turns left, then right, and returns to center while the torso and feet remain steady.
One arm lifts slightly and the hand makes a small friendly side-to-side wave, then lowers.
Head makes a modest celebratory nod and returns upright, with both feet planted.

style: Friendly hard-surface workshop robot with rounded blue and cream body panels, copper metal accents and restrained mechanical articulation.
subject: A friendly blue and cream workshop robot with copper metal details, a rounded torso, two arms and two planted feet, preserving the supplied model's existing hard-surface design.
